entry.author: AUT - Auckland University of Technology
entry.summary:
If you’d rather challenge yourself than stay comfortable, you’ve found the right place to work.

Auckland University of Technology (AUT) is one of the world’s leading young universities – a place where bold thinking, student-focused work and real-world impact come together.

Whether you’re an academic or professional staff member, this is where your work can move: across disciplines, across ideas, across careers and into the world.

Why work at AUT?
• Put your expertise to work where it can make a real difference
• Students at the centre of everything we do 
• A connected university where your contribution matters  
• The freedom to turn ideas into action 
• Opportunities to learn, grow and keep moving

Ready to do your best work – and have it count?

Explore careers at AUT:
Working at AUT https://www.aut.ac.nz/about/careers-at-aut 

#AUTUniversity #WorkingAtAUT #AcademicCareers #ProfessionalCareers #KnowledgeThatWorks
